# Ring MCP — Full Reference

FastMCP 3.4+ server (v1.0.4) for comprehensive Ring device management:
doorbells, cameras, alarms. Transports: stdio (Claude Desktop), HTTP REST
(FastAPI on :10729), Tauri desktop shell.

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|----------|---------|-------------|
| RING_USERNAME | Yes | — | Ring account email |
| RING_PASSWORD | Yes | — | Ring account password |
| RING_TOKEN | No | — | Existing OAuth token |
| HOST | No | 0.0.0.0 | Server bind address (LAN/Tailscale by design) |
| PORT | No | 10729 | HTTP API port |
| LOG_LEVEL | No | INFO | Logging level |
| RING_HTTP_API_ORIGIN | No | http://127.0.0.1:10729 | Base URL for web_sota |
| RING_LLM_BASE_URL | No | http://127.0.0.1:11434 | Local OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint |
| RING_LLM_MODEL | No | — | Default chat model id |
| RING_LLM_API_KEY | No | — | LLM API key (if the endpoint needs one) |
| RING_LLM_SYSTEM | No | (built-in) | System prompt for /api/v1/llm/chat |
| RING_MCP_LLM_GLOM | No | 1 | Startup LLM probe (0 disables) |
| RING_MQTT_ENABLED | No | — | Enable ring-mqtt bridge |
| RING_MQTT_URL | No | mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883 | MQTT broker URL |
| RING_MQTT_USERNAME | No | — | MQTT username |
| RING_MQTT_PASSWORD | No | — | MQTT password |
| RING_MQTT_TOPIC_PREFIX | No | ring | MQTT topic prefix |
| MCP_BRIDGE_URLS | No | — | Comma-separated MCP servers to proxy (composition) |
| MCP_PORT | No | — | run_server.py: set to serve HTTP, unset for stdio |
| METRICS_PORT | No | 8001 | Prometheus metrics port (server __main__) |

## Ports

- Frontend (Vite): 10728
- Backend (FastAPI): 10729
- Backend (stdio MCP): standard input/output

## MCP Tools (29, served)

### Security (alarm panel via device id, auto-detected when unambiguous)
- `get_security_system_status()` — System mode (never fabricated), devices, alerts
- `arm_security_system(mode, bypass_sensors?, delay_minutes?, device_id?)` — Real panel arm
- `disarm_security_system(force_disarm?, disarm_code?, device_id?)` — Real panel disarm
- `get_security_history(hours?, event_types?, include_video?)` — Real per-device events

### Doorbells
- `get_doorbell_status()` — Doorbell inventory with online/battery/firmware
- `get_doorbell_live_stream(doorbell_id?, quality?, duration_seconds?)` — WebRTC handoff (direct URLs retired)
- `answer_doorbell_call(...)` — Explicit unsupported (two-way audio not in backend)
- `get_visitor_history(hours?, include_snapshots?, motion_only?)` — Real events + analysis
- `configure_motion_detection(...)` — Explicit unsupported (not exposed by wrapper)

### Cameras
- `get_camera_status()` — Camera inventory + recent events
- `stream_all_cameras()` — Per-camera readiness (WebRTC handoff, honest failures)

### Fire safety
- `get_fire_alarm_status()` — Smoke/fire devices (type match), battery warnings
- `test_fire_safety_system()` — Pass/warn/fail per device from live state

### Monitoring
- `monitor_system_health()` — 0-100 score, offline/low-battery, recommendations
- `get_real_time_activity()` — Live event feed across devices

### Automation
- `create_security_automation(trigger_type, trigger_conditions, response_actions, automation_name, enabled?)`
- `trigger_emergency_protocol()` — Arms online panels, records incident (DESTRUCTIVE)
- `schedule_security_modes(schedule_config, timezone?)`

### System / status
- `get_system_status(include_device_details?, check_connectivity?)` — Auth + devices + connectivity
- `check_authentication_status()` — Real connect + device-read proof
- `check_device_connectivity(device_id?, test_commands?)` — Per-device latency + score
- `get_service_health(include_metrics?, history_minutes?)` — Component scores, alerts
- `list_devices(device_type?)` — MCP inventory mirror of GET /api/v1/devices
- `show_devices_card()` / `show_health_card()` — Prefab in-chat cards
- `ring_shutdown()` — Graceful server shutdown

### Help
- `list_available_tools(category?, include_hidden?)` — 29-entry catalog
- `get_tool_help(tool_name, include_examples?)`
- `search_tools(query, category?, limit?)`

### Prompts / resources (served)
- Prompts: `ring-security-check`, `ring-incident-triage`
- Resources: `ring://devices`, `ring://health`

## Architecture

```
ring_mcp/
  __init__.py         — stdio entry (serves create_app() surface)
  __main__.py         — python -m ring_mcp (create_app, stdio)
  run_server.py       — dual transport (MCP_PORT -> HTTP, else stdio)
  server.py           — FastMCP factory (29 tools + prompts + resources + Prefab cards)
  composition.py      — Multi-server composition/proxy support
  http_server.py      — FastAPI REST + WebSocket signaling + fleet contract endpoints
  local_llm.py        — Local LLM proxy (Ollama/LM Studio compatible)
  ring_mqtt_bridge.py — MQTT bridge for Ring Alarm base station
  api_log_buffer.py   — In-memory log ring buffer for the Logger page
  core/
    ring_client_modern.py — Async Ring API client (THE live client)
    ring_client.py        — Legacy sync client (deprecated, do not use for new tools)
    token_manager.py      — OAuth token management
    port_manager.py       — Port conflict resolution
    exceptions.py         — Custom exception hierarchy
  tools/
    security_system_tools.py, doorbell_tools.py, fire_safety_tools.py,
    camera_tools.py, monitoring_tools.py, automation_tools.py,
    help_tool.py, status_tool.py

web_sota/              — Vite + React fleet UI (:10728)
native/                — Tauri 2.0 desktop shell (NSIS installer)
```

## REST API Endpoints (served, verified)

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| /api/v1/health | GET | Detailed health status (launcher probe) |
| /api/v1/status | GET | Device counts by family |
| /api/v1/devices | GET | List all devices (?q= filter) |
| /api/v1/devices/{id} | GET | Device details |
| /api/v1/devices/{id}/events | GET | Device events |
| /api/v1/devices/{id}/stream | GET | Stream info |
| /api/v1/devices/{id}/stream/live | GET | Live stream state |
| /api/v1/devices/{id}/stream/webrtc | WS | WebRTC signaling socket |
| /api/v1/webrtc/offer | POST | SDP offer -> answer (REST signaling) |
| /api/v1/webrtc/candidate | POST | ICE candidate relay |
| /api/v1/webrtc/keepalive/{id} | POST | Keep stream alive |
| /api/v1/webrtc/close/{id} | POST | Close stream |
| /api/v1/snapshot/{id} | GET | Still snapshot |
| /api/v1/devices/{id}/arm | POST | Arm/disarm (MQTT panel or Ring API) |
| /api/v1/devices/{id}/chime | POST | Trigger chime |
| /api/v1/devices/{id}/intercom/start | POST | 501 (not implemented, honest) |
| /api/v1/devices/{id}/intercom/stop | POST | 501 (not implemented, honest) |
| /api/v1/auth/configure | POST | Save Ring credentials |
| /api/v1/llm/models | GET | Local LLM model list |
| /api/v1/llm/chat | POST | Chat completion via local LLM proxy |
| /api/v1/llm/discover | GET | Local LLM presence probe |
| /api/v1/llm/providers | GET | Provider registry (never key bytes) |
| /api/v1/llm/onboarding | GET | Starter facts + recommended path |
| /api/v1/logs | GET | Recent logs from ring buffer |
| /api/capabilities | GET | Fleet capability shape |
| /api/v1/system/info | GET | Version/uptime/tool count (CUA smoke) |
| /api/v1/diagnostics | GET | Backend/system/tools diagnostics (CUA smoke) |
| /api/skills | GET | Skill listing (SKILL.md frontmatter) |
| /api/shutdown | POST | Orderly exit (200 now, exit 0.5s later) |
| /docs | GET | Swagger UI |
| /redoc | GET | ReDoc API docs |
| /openapi.json | GET | OpenAPI schema |

## Transport Modes

- **stdio**: Claude Desktop (`python -m ring_mcp`, `ring-mcp` script)
- **HTTP**: REST API on port 10729 (uvicorn `ring_mcp.http_server:app`)
- **Tauri**: Embedded backend + WebView (CSP allows :10728/:10729)
